Hi Samantha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive (30–45m):

- Recap: you care most about inference latency at 95th pct for short-cls requests, multi-tenant data isolation, and SSO/KMS for auditability.
- Proposed next-step: technical deep-dive (solutions + infra) to walk performance profile, deployment modes (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and initial rollout plan.

Two slot options from our side (PT):
- Tue Mar 23, 10:00–10:45 AM PT
- Wed Mar 24, 2:00–2:45 PM PT

Could you confirm which works best and who from ClearWave will attend (specific names + roles)? If neither works, send 2 options and we’ll adapt. I attached a one-pager with the product summary and a first-pass SOW for context.

Agenda (draft):
1) 5–7m: goals & success metrics
2) 10–15m: architecture + runtime considerations (batching, KV cache, quantization options)
3) 10–15m: security/compliance (SSO/KMS, audit logs)
4) 5m: next steps & rollout cadence

If Michael (platform lead) will join, we can add a short section on network topology and VPC options.

Thanks — I’ll hold both slots tentatively until I hear from you.

—
